definition: Own autonomy-power — Śiva's power of self-aware autonomy, by which he is conscious of himself and manifests the world without being affected by it. Synonymous with spanda and Śakti. The power that makes Śiva both the manifester and the witness of manifestation.

sources.claim: Spanda is the Power of Śiva by which He is conscious of Himself

translations.note: 'Own autonomy-power' captures the self-governing, self-aware aspect; 'power' alone is too generic.
